notes.title: Minor Bug Build
notes.notes:
Added more save slots to STEAM version!

See full patch notes here: https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes

notes.title: BSoD Bug Fix
notes.notes: New users should no longer experience a blue screen of death upon opening the app for the first time. (Patches the dragon will miss you...)

notes.title: Lute Drop Today!
notes.notes: [p]Over nine new designs for lutes have been added. Swap out the body and neck to mix and match and even add an enchantment for those particularly magical riffs.[/p]

notes.title: Small Hotfix
notes.notes:
Dragging the object in the iconmaker now correctly saves.
See full patch notes here: https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes

notes.title: IconMaker!
notes.notes:
Feature update! Now you can make icons for your items! Design a square or circular icon, position and size your weapon or armor (or potion) how you'd like and then set a glow and background color.

These icons are perfect for using in a Virtual Tabletop to represent your custom items.

notes.title: Iconmaker Released!
notes.notes: Feature update! Now you can make icons for your items! Design a square or circular icon, position and size your weapon or armor (or potion) how you'd like and then set a glow and background color!

notes.title: Ready! Aim! ... Build Firearms!
notes.notes: Pistols and muskets are now live in-app. Choose from dozens of designs, swapping out the barrel, grip or stock, and attachments, such as bayonets, ammo cases, and dragon-head embellishments.

notes.title: Firearms are live!
notes.notes: Pistols and Muskets have been added! Perfect loot for pirates, highwaymen, duelists, and rebels!  See full patch notes here: https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes

notes.title: Found in Translation!
notes.notes:
Translations for most in-app features now available for Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, French and Russian!

See full patch notes [url=https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes]here[/url].

notes.title: Language Support Added!
notes.notes:
Translations for most in-app features now available for Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, French and Russian!

See full patch notes [url=https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes]here[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix.
notes.notes:
Two minor fixes added.
1. Change font should now work.
2. A rare crash on downloading a file is now fixed.

notes.title: Fear the Reaper!
notes.notes:
Scythes have been added! There are various new designs, ranging from farm implements, to necromantic, to steampunk!

[url=https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes]https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes[/url]

notes.title: Fear the Reaper!
notes.notes:
Scythes have been added for your reaping pleasure! Create your own using parts ranging from traditional farm implements, to those of a grim persuasion, and even steampunk pieces.

See full patch notes here: [url=https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes]https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes[/url]

notes.title: Magic Item Stats
notes.notes: Added ability to roll random stats for magic items and minor bug fixes. See full patch notes here: [url=https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes]https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes[/url]

notes.title: Spellbound!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005838/7ca36579131fcbe09064ee2efa437113f6161b09.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005838/6477925925423fb1d110416d34723f4a922691a4.png[/img][/url]

Spellbooks are now in Instant Armory! Create a tattered old journal as a quest item, or the spellbook made of dried halfling skin that the neighborhood lich uses. The choices are yours!

notes.title: Enchantments on Jewelry and Gauntlets!
notes.notes:
This patch adds enchantments to Jewelry and Gauntlets.  Full patch notes here:
https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes/

notes.title: Put a Ring on It!
notes.notes: Rings and amulets are now included in Instant Armory! You can create traditional jewelry with golden bands and gemstones or strange magical pieces made of twigs or coral or bone - or mix and match and recolor parts to your heart's content. Get in there and add visuals to your Rings of Warding and Amulets of Truthseeing!

notes.title: Spells Added!
notes.notes: Spells have been added to Instant Armory, as well as many quality of life updates. Check out everything here: https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes/

notes.title: New Guantlets!
notes.notes:
Six new gauntlets added, as well as some features specifically for STEAM users.  Note: This update may require a reinstall.

See full patch notes here: https://trapstreetstudios.com/InstantArmory/patchnotes/

notes.title: Weapon Enchantments!
notes.notes: Weapon enchantments have now been added to Instant Armory! Wreath your blade in verdant flames, let vermillion lightning run up the length of your staff, make snowflakes fall around your polearm, or have black arcane sigils grace your warhammer.  Any combination. Any colour. The options are yours!
